title: Fishing mini game where I can choose how far  I cast my line out.

posts.author: nohands
posts.body: How would I make an action in RPG Maker MZ where I can cast my fishing line out into the water two or three tiles instead of just dropping the line the water. Can anyone help I am new to posting at the forum.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
create a event with a Input.longPressed("BUTTON") >= 60
the higher than 60 means 1 seconds (or 1 tile) you can make conditions
to check if its longPress of 180  (3 tiles) 120 for 2 tiles, 60 for 1 tile.
this might be the easiest way, but not the best efficient way.
as there are more methodes, this might be starters way to test it out.
you can also set $gameVariables.value(x)  and event that bit which can
also be evented as a little more advanced.

posts.author: kirbwarrior
posts.body: If fishing isn't a heavy action minigame, you could use Show Choice or Input Number and simply let the player choose a number of how far to send it out.
